scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,gamefinder -c blue,green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host" "npm --prefix apps/gamefinder run dev"

scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix apps/gamefinder run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix apps/gamefinder run format
